outcome: maternal outcome (pulmonary edema, HELLP syndrome, visual impairment, postpartum hemorrhage, eclampsia)
finding: Advanced maternal age (>35 years old) in women with preeclampsia was associated with poorer maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to women of reproductive age (20-34 years old).
mod_finding: The prevalence of cesarean delivery was more common in the advanced maternal age group compared to the reproductive age group.
